title: Business Office Computation of the UIL Academic and Robotics Team Participation Fee, 2026-27 (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**The participation fee.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the participation fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** that posts with the signed participation packet is the scheduled participation fee: the UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation fee of the activity fee catalogue, rounded to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The fee is assembled in this order: amounts are added together first, the shares are then applied one after the other to that total, never below 0.00, and the result is rounded once, at the end, to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

## Reading the order (hypothetical figures)

The order fixes three things: the total of the amounts is formed before any share acts; each share acts on what the previous one left; the cent is fixed only at the end.

| Step of assembly | Hypothetical figures | Running figure |
|---|---|---|
| amounts added together | 52.00 and minus 6.50 | 45.50 |
| total never below 0.00 | 45.50 | 45.50 |
| a first share of 115 percent | 45.50 multiplied by 1.15 | 52.325 |
| a second share of 85 percent, on that figure | 52.325 multiplied by 0.85 | 44.47625 |
| rounded once, half a cent up | | 44.48 |

Every intermediate figure stays unrounded; the cent is fixed once, on the final figure.

*Floor.* Amounts totalling a hypothetical minus 3.00 are taken as 0.00 before any share, and the fee is 0.00.
